title: Polynomial threshold representation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to the signs, and let $p:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$. The function $f$ is represented by the polynomial threshold of $p$ if, at every input $x$, its value is the threshold sign of $p(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs
$p$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
